text:
## Compensation Framework  
**Financial Compensation Guidelines:**  
| Scenario | Compensation Range | Basis |
|----------|-------------------|-------|
| Service delay (1–2 days) | £0–£50 | Inconvenience |
| Service delay (3–5 days) | £50–£100 | Operational disruption |
| Service failure (>5 days) | £100–£300 | Significant impact |
| Financial loss (error) | Full loss + 8% interest | Actual loss + interest |
| Serious distress | £250–£500+ | Emotional impact |  
**Limits:**
- <£100: Customer Service Manager approval
- £100–£500: Director approval
- >£500: CEO approval
- >£1,000: Board notification + CEO approval

raw_entities.description: A formal policy establishing financial compensation guidelines for service delays, service failures, financial losses, and customer distress. The policy defines compensation ranges based on scenario severity and establishes approval authority thresholds ranging from Customer Service Manager to Board level.
context: Financial loss (error) | Full loss + 8% interest | Actual loss + interest

raw_entities.name: Service Delay Compensation for One to Two Days
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring compensation of £0–£50 for service delays lasting one to two days, based on inconvenience caused to the customer.

raw_entities.name: Service Delay Compensation for Three to Five Days
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring compensation of £50–£100 for service delays lasting three to five days, based on operational disruption caused to the customer.

raw_entities.name: Service Failure Compensation for More Than Five Days
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring compensation of £100–£300 for service failures lasting more than five days, based on significant impact to the customer.

raw_entities.name: Financial Loss Compensation with Interest
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring compensation equal to the full financial loss incurred by the customer plus 8% interest, applicable when the bank's error causes direct financial loss.
context: Financial loss (error) | Full loss + 8% interest | Actual loss + interest

raw_entities.name: Serious Distress Compensation
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring compensation of £250–£500 or more for cases involving serious distress to the customer, based on emotional impact assessment.

raw_entities.name: Compensation Approval Authority for Amounts Under £100
raw_entities.description: Provision establishing that compensation awards under £100 require approval from the Customer Service Manager.

raw_entities.name: Compensation Approval Authority for Amounts £100 to £500
raw_entities.description: Provision establishing that compensation awards between £100 and £500 require approval from a Director.

raw_entities.name: Compensation Approval Authority for Amounts Over £500
raw_entities.description: Provision establishing that compensation awards exceeding £500 require CEO approval.

raw_entities.name: Board Notification for Compensation Awards Over £1,000
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring Board notification in addition to CEO approval for compensation awards exceeding £1,000.

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Manager
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for approving compensation awards under £100 in accordance with the Compensation Framework policy.

raw_entities.name: Director
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for approving compensation awards between £100 and £500 in accordance with the Compensation Framework policy.

raw_entities.name: Chief Executive Officer
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for approving compensation awards exceeding £500 and for providing approval for awards over £1,000 in conjunction with Board notification.

raw_entities.name: Board
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for receiving notification of compensation awards exceeding £1,000, which also require CEO approval.
